svg.title: Three-tier web application on AWS
svg.desc: Three-tier web application on AWS. 11 components in 12 groups. Connections: Users to Internet gateway; Internet gateway to Application Load Balancer; Application Load Balancer to Web server; Application Load Balancer to Web server; Internet gateway to NAT gateway; Internet gateway to NAT gateway; NAT gateway to Web server; NAT gateway to Web server; Web server to Amazon Aurora; Web server to Amazon ElastiCache; Web server to Amazon Aurora; Web server to Amazon ElastiCache; Web server to Data subnet (writes).

text.tspan: Load-balanced EC2 web tier across two Availability Zones, Aurora and ElastiCache in private subnets
